newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Sept 18.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Sept. 18:
WASHINGTON - A higher percentage of people filing for bankruptcy are doing so without early warning signs.
WASHINGTON - The Federal Trade Commission said Exxon Corp. is overcharging for its 93 Supreme because of claims it will make engines cleaner and cheaper to maintain.
WASHINGTON - Network television viewers are deserting in droves, but advertisers keep paying ever-higher prices for commercial airtime.
WASHINGTON - International Business Machines Corp is preparing to offer a voluntary employee buyout plan to a few thousand eligible employees in a renewed effort to restructure its work force.
